name: After § 12
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 12a. Is concerned by the underutilisation and ineffectiveness of Council Directive 2000/43/EC1a of 29 June 2000 implementing the principle of equal treatment between persons irrespective of racial or ethnic origin, commonly known as the Racial Equality Directive; calls for stronger enforcement of EU anti-discrimination law especially laws prohibiting racial and anti-Muslim discrimination; calls on the Commission to follow up with legislative action to address the gaps in the directive as identified in its 2022 study report, notably regarding discrimination in law enforcement and racial profiling; 1a Council Directive 2000/43/EC of 29 June 2000 implementing the principle of equal treatment between persons irrespective of racial or ethnic origin (OJ L 180, 19.7.2000, p. 22, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2000/43/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2000/43/oj)).
